review.identity: Broad adult face and broad nose, brown hair and close beard, blue plain workshirt and off-white apron straps retain identity. Age reads adult around thirty. Calm closed mouth and practical gaze distinguish him from worried Tore.
review.composition: Face still loses room to long visible neck and neckline; right-side hair touches canvas boundary. Crown and chin remain visible.
review.style: Hard stepped silhouettes and broad warm planes read at 1x. Hair has too many fine spike separations and beard has excess mottled small clusters; eye whites are restrained but present.
review.requested_revision: Tighter adult face, short neck and lower chin, compact clean hair silhouette with contained margins, larger connected beard planes; retain calm expression.

approval_scope: Candidate review only; no native or runtime approval
